Marketplace.noResourcesSub: Try adjusting your filters or search query.

About.heroDesc1: UniCare isn't just a platform; it's a movement. We are democratizing engineering resources through a soft, welcoming, and artistic lens. In a world of rigid code, we find the art in collaboration.
About.heroDesc2: Our community-driven resource-sharing platform is designed specifically for engineers who value open-source innovation but crave a space that feels human, creative, and accessible.
About.valuesSubtitle: We believe in the power of shared knowledge. Every feature we build is guided by these core principles.
About.value1Desc: Empowering engineers to build better together through accessible code, shared blueprints, and transparent tools.
About.value2Desc: Fostering a supportive environment where every contribution is valued, from the first PR to major architectural shifts.
About.value3Desc: Blending technical precision with an aesthetic approach. We believe beautiful tools inspire beautiful work.
About.narrativeDesc: From humble beginnings as a small repository to a thriving ecosystem, UniCare has always been about more than just code. It's about the people behind the screen. We are crafting a narrative where technology serves humanity with grace and style.

Contribute.heroTitle: Build the Future of University Resources
Contribute.heroDesc: Join our community of contributors. Whether you're into feature development, server hosting, or core engineering, there's a place for you at UniCare.
Contribute.betaDesc: Be among the first to try our upcoming AI-powered student verification, smart lending system, and real-time community tools — and help us refine them before they go live across universities.
Contribute.formDesc: Interested in shaping UniCare? Fill out the form to get involved in our development cycle. We are looking for passionate individuals who care about open engineering culture.
